Home Made Limoncello
By: Sophie32
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




5 larges organic lemons, skin not treated with chemicals. I buy mine  my Bio food health shop.
400 grs of fine white caster sugar
500 mls of water
500 mls of unflavoured alcohol. I chose Vodka von Smirnoff.

Preparation

1 Peel the lemons with a vegetable peeler. You only want the yellow skin, no pits & no white bits. Cut them into little bits & place them into a large & wide cleaned pot. 2 After all this is done, add the 500 ml of vodka to the pot. Seal the pot well with a fitting lid. Shake the pot up & down for a while so that everything is well combined. 3 Place the filled pot in a dark & cool place, not the fridge for about 1 week. Occasionally, shake the pot up & down so that everything will soak well. 4 After a week, you will see that the vodka will be flavoured with the lemon peels & will be yellow in colour. 5 Now, you take a large strainer & put a fitting bowl under it. You pour the liquid carefully trough the strainer & push the liquid out of the lemon peels, that stay behind. With the help of a spoon you push as many liquid out of the lemon peels as you can. 6 Now, you can make your syrop. Place the 400 gr of sugar in a cooking pot & add the 500 ml of water. Stir frequently. Bring to the boil. Let it boil for about 5 minutes until you ca n see trough your syrop. Take it off the stove & let it cool. 7 Now, add the cooled syrup to the vodka infused lemon peels & pour the limoncello in cleaned bottles or into clean pots. Place them into a dark place, hidden from direct sunlight for another 2 to 3 weeks. Shake the bottles from time to time up & down. 8 After 3 weeks, your limoncello will be ready! 9 Store : in the freezer or in the fridge. You have to drink it cold & then it is nice & lovely! 10 How to use? 11 It is lovely to drink after dinner, 12 To put into desserts & cakes 13 It is lovely in fruit salads, in cocktails, in ice creams, etc. 14 I also use it in my savoury dishes

About


Recently, I made my first home made limoncello.
I love Limoncello. Limoncello is easy to make.
